# PayPal

Skills that teach agents to work with PayPal. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [paypal/AI-Toolkit](https://github.com/paypal/AI-Toolkit), at commit `5dce83d`.

PayPal development plugin for Claude — integrate payments, subscriptions, invoices, disputes, and more using PayPal's APIs and MCP server

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **PayPal**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **PayPal**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install paypal@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

2 skills: `paypal-best-practices`, `paypal-routing`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

It ships no scripts. The skills are guidance for the agent.

The skills mention these environment variables for credentials: `PAYPAL_SECRET`. This plugin does not store them.

## Docs

- Vendor repository: https://github.com/paypal/AI-Toolkit
